name: Honeycomb Yard no Dragmakhia
original_name: ハニカムヤードのドラグマキア
source:
A mysterious catastrophe drove the humanity out of the lands.
Now surviving people live peacefully in an underground shelter called "Honeycombyard".
The lost world has been going away from people's memory across generations.
An assistant detective Haruto Kisaragi, who works at Ayaka Amagi's detective office,
is ordered by Ayaka to search for a stray cat Lieselotte with his coworkers.
When they find Lieselotte she transforms into a monster. Haruo also transforms
into a dragonewt, getting into a combat. A digital novel of supernatural ability battle mystery.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE226933.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一场神秘灾难将人类赶出了这片土地。

如今，幸存者们在名为“蜂巢庭院”的地下避难所中和平生活。

失落的世界跨越一代又一代，逐渐从人们的记忆中远去。

如月春人与天城绫香在侦探事务所工作，是她手下的助手侦探。绫香命令他与同事一起寻找走失的猫莉泽洛特。

他们找到莉泽洛特时，她却变身成了怪物。春人也变身为龙人，陷入一场战斗。这是一部以超能力战斗为主题的悬疑数字小说。
